$note: Single source of truth for cross-language test taxonomy dimensions (plan item C13, attempt #6 of this vocabulary — the only difference this time is that C18's lint turns an unknown dimension into a CI failure). Each dimension maps onto its representation in each test language: pytest_marker (server/pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options].markers), csharp_category (unity-plugin/Editor/TestSupport/TestCategories.cs public const string), and dsl_header_value (a .playtest '# @needs'/'# @tags' token recognized by PlaytestHeaderScanner.cs). A null field means that language/layer has no equivalent for this dimension. scripts/tests/test_taxonomy_map.py cross-checks every non-null pytest_marker/csharp_category value against its real source of truth, independently in both directions.

_excluded_pytest_markers.timeout: per-test timeout override (pytest-timeout), a pytest mechanism, not a taxonomy dimension
_excluded_pytest_markers.asyncio: auto-registered by pytest-asyncio; registered explicitly only because of --strict-markers, not a taxonomy dimension
